in_sanskrit.name: Kukila
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kukila is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kukila' which means 'nightjar'. In Hindu mythology, the nightjar is believed to be the vehicle of the goddess Kali. The name is also associated with the goddess Kali herself, as she is often referred to as 'Kukila Kali'.

in_hindi.name: कुकिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kuyil is transliterated as 'कुकिला' in Hindi. The meaning of the name in Hindi is 'कुकबरा', which translates to 'nightjar' or 'cuckoo' in English.

in_tamil.name: குயில்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kuyil is written as 'குயில்' in Tamil. The meaning of the name in Tamil is 'குறியிட்டு அரிச்சியாள்', which translates to 'the one who is longing for love' or 'the one who is yearning for a lover'.

in_telugu.name: కుయిల
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Kuyil is transliterated as 'కుయిల' in Telugu. The meaning of the name in Telugu is 'జనపద్దతి', which translates to 'the one who is friendly to all' or 'the one who is kind to everyone'.
